svg.title: SHAKEDOWN - Fox Showdown
svg.desc: A single full-screen 2560 by 1440 game title image. Uses unmodified pixels from existing Cinnamon, Fox, Shake, and South Quad assets, composited as a bold noir-action design.
svg.text: A FOX. A FIGHT. A FURIOUS RED PANDA.
